source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: As your [Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase) finishes, Feirros can pick one **ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE** model from your army within 3″ of him. It heals 3 wounds. The same model may ignore modifiers to Movement and Ballistic Skill. It can also disregard modifiers on **[Hit rolls](vsdata:core-rule/hit-rolls)** or **[Wound rolls](vsdata:core-rule/wound-rolls)**. Both permissions end when your next [Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase) begins.
